stackanvil_foundry.title: Bedrock Foundry
stackanvil_foundry.open_desktop.tooltip: Sign in, download Marketplace add-ons, and create or set up servers in Bedrock Foundry. Close it before you start a server here.
stackanvil_foundry.busy: Bedrock Foundry is running a server. Stop it to refresh the list or open Foundry.
stackanvil_foundry.install_first: Install BDS for this server in Bedrock Foundry first.
stackanvil_foundry.missing: Bedrock Foundry is not on your PATH. Install it, or enter the path to its executable.
stackanvil_foundry.missing_configured: The saved Bedrock Foundry path is not an executable file. Enter the path to bedrock-foundry.
stackanvil_foundry.list_failed: Bedrock Foundry could not list its servers: %s
stackanvil_foundry.empty: Bedrock Foundry has no servers. Open Foundry to create one, install BDS, and add your add-ons.
stackanvil_foundry.choose: Choose a server to start it and join.
stackanvil_foundry.running: %s is running at %s. It stops when you press Stop or quit the game.
